blocks.text: Cookies chhoti files hain jo websites aap ke device par rakh deti hain jab aap unhein kholte hain. In ki madad se website cheezein yaad rakhti hai, jaise aap ki login details aur aap ki pasand (preferences).

Misal: Jab aap Pakistan mein kisi online shopping site par jate hain to cookies aap ki login maloomat save kar leti hain, is liye har dafa dobara likhni nahi parti. Lekin cookies aap ki online activities ko track (peecha) bhi kar sakti hain, jaise aap kaunse products dekhte hain, ta ke aap ki dilchaspi ke mutabiq ads (ishtihar) dikhaye jayein. Yeh tracking personalized ads (aap ke liye chune hue ishtihar) mein madad karti hai, magar is ka matlab yeh bhi hai ke aap ki browsing dekhi ja rahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Cookies faidemand bhi hain aur privacy mein dakhal bhi; har ek ki misal dein. (Short question 3)
blocks.explanation: Faidemand: shopping site cookies ke zariye aap ki login maloomat yaad rakhti hai, to har dafa login nahi karna parta. Privacy mein dakhal: cookies aap ke dekhe hue products track karti hain aur un ki bunyad par ishtihar dikhaye jate hain, yaani aap ki browsing dekhi ja rahi hoti hai.

items: Cookies: websites ki rakhi chhoti files; login aur pasand yaad rakhti hain, magar browsing track kar ke ads bhi dikhati hain.
